correctness.rationale: Fixed barycentric orbit lemma is general. In the complete claimed finite range n=2..8 and both reflection classes, every perfect matching, invariant face, and orbit face is explicitly generated; 14 exact equalities are asserted and checked by included program. Every collapse is a verified elementary free-face pair. The n=8 edge-reflection reduction has 65 pairs, core 8 vertices/15 edges/8 triangles, an 8-generator 8-relator CW model, seven valid one-cell/two-cell cancellations and one null-homotopic remaining 2-cell, proving S1 wedge S2 integrally. Smaller residual complexes are points or graphs; no infinite extrapolation.
